exclusion: Life expectation of less than two years because of a non neurological disease
inclusion: Patients with unclear parkinsonism at the outpatient clinic

inquiry.body:
Hello,

I am interested in learning about eligibility for Transcranial Duplex Scanning and Single Photon Emission Computer Tomography (SPECT) in Parkinsonian Syndromes (NCT00368199).

Thank you.
inquiry.subject: Inquiry about participating in NCT00368199

official_title: Diagnostic Value Transcranial Duplex Scanning and Single Photon Emission Tomography in Patients Suspected of Having Idiopathic Parkinson Disease or Atypical Parkinson Syndromes
summary: The purpose of the study is to determine the sensitivity and specificity of transcranial duplex scanning (TCD) and single photon emission computer tomography (SPECT) in patients suspected of having Idiopathic Parkinson Disease (PD) or Atypical Parkinson Syndromes (APS) with as golden standard the clinical diagnosis after 2-year follow-up.
title: Transcranial Duplex Scanning and Single Photon Emission Computer Tomography (SPECT) in Parkinsonian Syndromes
